test_results: Lipid panel improved: LDL down to 110 mg/dL. ECG: Normal sinus rhythm.
previous_visits: Diagnosed with hypertension and hyperlipidemia. On Telmisartan 40mg and Rosuvastatin 10mg.
transcript:
Doctor: Good afternoon Mrs. Sharma. How have you been feeling since we adjusted your medications?
Patient: Good afternoon Doctor. Much better! I don't feel the lightheadedness anymore, and I've been walking 30 minutes daily.
Doctor: That's wonderful. Your blood pressure today is 132/82, which is a great improvement from 142/86 last time.
Patient: Should I continue the same tablets?
Doctor: Yes, continue Telmisartan 40mg in the morning and Rosuvastatin 10mg at bedtime. Keep up the daily walks and low-salt diet. We will see you back in 6 months.
